# The sheet stack (openSheet / runSheet / closeSheet / onEscape / askBeforeDiscard / Advanced),
# one act per block, each on a fresh page. "facts" is the scrim, body scroll lock and the page's
# sheet state; "focus" is every element the page called focus() on during the act.

## openSheet: the style menu's Rename sheet, then Cancel
before: scrim inactive, markup empty, body overflow "", S.sheet null, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null
after Style B ⋯ › Rename: scrim active, markup drawn, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null
modal: class "pd-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Rename Style B"
header: "Rename Style B", sub ""
fields: name
footer: status(st) · pd-btn [sheet-cancel] "Cancel" · pd-btn primary [sheet-ok] "Rename"
inner popover: #pd-advpop, hidden
focus: none
active element: none
pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop hidden
after Cancel: scrim inactive, markup empty, body overflow "", S.sheet null, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null
focus: none (none returned to the ⋯ that opened it)

## a click on the scrim outside the modal (pd-scrim carries no data-backdrop-close)
after: scrim active, markup drawn, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null

## runSheet: OK pressed twice before the first write answers
between the presses: scrim active, markup drawn, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet running, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null, OK disabled
requests: PUT /api/styles/2 · POST /api/processes/1/flow/preview
after: scrim inactive, markup empty, body overflow "", S.sheet null, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null

## runSheet: a refused run, then OK again
first press: PUT /api/styles/2 → sheet: open "Rename Style B", status "the Edge refused it" (bad), OK "Rename" enabled
second press: PUT /api/styles/2 · POST /api/processes/1/flow/preview → sheet: closed

## closeSheet: what it clears (Add positions on Settings)
open Add positions, NEW_1 ticked: scrim active, markup drawn, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null; S.addPos set; pickers addpos, parts, rs_destination, rs_source, rs_staging
after Cancel: scrim inactive, markup empty, body overflow "", S.sheet null, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null; S.addPos null; pickers parts, rs_destination, rs_source, rs_staging (Settings' own pickers stay: their boxes are in #pd-root)

## closeSheet: the apply modal's ticks go with it
apply modal, Style B ticked: scrim active, markup drawn, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null; S.papply rows 2
after Cancel: scrim inactive, markup empty, body overflow "", S.sheet null, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null; S.papply null
reopened: nothing ticked

## closeSheet: New style's spots go with it
New style, Recipe One picked: scrim active, markup drawn, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null; S.newStyle set
after Cancel: scrim inactive, markup empty, body overflow "", S.sheet null, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null; S.newStyle null

## Escape: the page popover (#pd-pop) with no sheet
style menu open: pd-pop open, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent
Escape → scrim inactive, markup empty, body overflow "", S.sheet null, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent

## Escape: Settings' group list (#pd-stpop)
Settings group list open: pd-pop absent, pd-stpop open, pd-advpop absent
Escape → scrim inactive, markup empty, body overflow "", S.sheet null, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null; pd-pop absent, pd-stpop hidden, pd-advpop absent

## Escape: a popover in a sheet (#pd-advpop), then the sheet (nothing typed)
Add process with its group list open: scrim active, markup drawn, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop open
Escape → scrim active, markup drawn, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop hidden
Escape → scrim inactive, markup empty, body overflow "", S.sheet null, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent

## Escape: Advanced's own picker, then Advanced (nothing typed)
Advanced open on POS_A1: scrim active, markup drawn, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet null, S.adv set, S.escapeHold null
modal: class "pd-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="POS_A1 Advanced"
header: "POS_A1 · Advanced", sub "Style A · settings the flow doesn’t draw. They ride along with this position when the flow is saved from either screen."
footer: status(st) · pd-btn [adv-cancel] "Cancel" · pd-btn primary [adv-apply] "Apply"
its first picker (allowed_payload_codes) clicked: pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop open
Escape → scrim active, markup drawn, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet null, S.adv set, S.escapeHold null; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop hidden
Escape → scrim inactive, markup empty, body overflow "", S.sheet null, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent

## askBeforeDiscard on Advanced: a typed number, Escape, Keep editing, Escape, Discard
typed 7 into reorder_point: S.adv.a.reorder_point=7
Escape → sheet "Discard the changes?"; scrim active, markup drawn, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, S.adv set, S.escapeHold set; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent
Escape again, with the question up: sheet "Discard the changes?" (only its buttons answer)
Keep editing → sheet "POS_A1 · Advanced", reorder_point field reads "7", S.adv.a.reorder_point=7; scrim active, markup drawn, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet null, S.adv set, S.escapeHold null
Escape → sheet "Discard the changes?"; scrim active, markup drawn, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, S.adv set, S.escapeHold set; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent
Discard → scrim inactive, markup empty, body overflow "", S.sheet null, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null

## askBeforeDiscard on a sheet: a typed name, Escape, Keep editing, OK
Escape → sheet "Discard the changes?"; scrim active, markup drawn, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, S.adv null, S.escapeHold set; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent
header: "Discard the changes?", sub "this sheet has typed work in it."
footer: status(st) · pd-btn [sheet-cancel] "Keep editing" · pd-btn danger [escape-discard] "Discard"
Keep editing → sheet "Rename Style B", name reads "Style B typed"; scrim active, markup drawn, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null
then OK (the held sheet's own run): PUT /api/styles/2 {"name":"Style B typed","description":"","process_id":1,"expected_catid":""}

## askBeforeDiscard on a sheet: a typed name, Escape, Discard
Escape → sheet "Discard the changes?"; scrim active, markup drawn, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, S.adv null, S.escapeHold set; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent
Discard → scrim inactive, markup empty, body overflow "", S.sheet null, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null; requests none

## Escape with no layer: a pinned recipe group lets go
recipe group 0 pinned: S.shapeDraft.focus {"g":0}
Escape → S.shapeDraft.focus null; scrim inactive, markup empty, body overflow "", S.sheet null, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent

## Escape with no layer: the selected position lets go (then nothing)
row POS_A3 clicked: S.selected "POS_A3"
Escape → S.selected null; scrim inactive, markup empty, body overflow "", S.sheet null, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent
Escape → S.selected null; scrim inactive, markup empty, body overflow "", S.sheet null, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent

## the Advanced sheet: open, Cancel, open, Apply
open: scrim active, markup drawn, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet null, S.adv set, S.escapeHold null
Cancel: scrim inactive, markup empty, body overflow "", S.sheet null, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null
reopened, Apply with nothing changed: scrim inactive, markup empty, body overflow "", S.sheet null, S.adv null, S.escapeHold null; dirty=true; requests POST /api/processes/1/flow/preview

## facts
body scroll lock: overflow "hidden" while a sheet is up, "" once it closes (showModal / hideModal; every block above)
focus() calls the page made across every block above: 0 — nothing moves focus into a sheet, and nothing returns it on close
Escape: one document keydown listener (boot, processes-desktop.js:138); the window listeners boot adds: error, unhandledrejection, resize, focus
